capabilities: Display a graph of file counts over time
Define file categories with path, folder-list and regex filters
Track file deletions on the graph
Maintain a CSV index of file creation dates
Read creation dates from a frontmatter date property
disambiguation: Tracks the number of files in the vault over time, not vault disk size.
extras: Graph rendering relies on the Apache ECharts library bundled with the plugin; feedback is via GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian shows the current file count but gives no way to see how the vault grew over time or how different file groups developed.

relations.evidence: Plugin uses Apache ECharts to render graphs.

summary: File-count history plugin that charts the number of files in the vault over time, with customizable per-category lines.
